title: Agentic AI: Current Capabilities and Future Directions
summary: Agentic AI involves AI agents performing actions in the world, contrasting with generative AI that creates content. Challenges include limited training data and the need for trial-and-error learning. Applications range from coding agents to high-stakes areas, with potential risks of misuse and ethical concerns.
key_points: Agentic AI agents take actions in the world, unlike generative AI which creates content.
Challenges include limited training data and the need for trial-and-error learning.
Future agentic AI may require different architectures to handle various data types.
limitations: Extracted public HTML text; source claims not independently verified. No research-baseline comparison.
